summary: Alientrap's Nexuiz Classic is a free/open-source arena FPS, distinct from the later commercial CryEngine remake that reused the name.

entries.title: Nexuiz

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Nexuiz Classic 2.5.2 with renderer/config documented

primary.why: The original Nexuiz is the free/open-source DarkPlaces arena shooter now preserved as Nexuiz Classic. The later 2012 commercial Nexuiz is a different CryEngine game and should not replace the classic route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official Nexuiz Classic 2.5.2 package or a distro/SourceForge package. Record OS, build/source, renderer/settings, bot count, map, mode, server/LAN state, config, and whether Xonotic or the 2012 commercial Nexuiz was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only as follow-up lineage comparison.
secondary.why: Xonotic is important to the history but is a fork, not the original Nexuiz entry.

secondary.exclusive_content: Commercial CryEngine remake using the same name
secondary.what_to_play: Archive separately if it appears in the queue.
secondary.why: It differs in engine, ownership, and design.
